Hello, i think a super simple notification system that sent a reply to requests would be super good and come in handy when people decline any of your requests, or even accepted them instead of not being sure if the request has gone through or not, accepted or not... 

This would make the spam of requests to an end in my opinion, and its a great addition. 

Little details makes everything better ^-^
